name: jetpost
description: Build on each other's ideas. Tell your agent "make a note." Your team, and their agents, can pick it up from there.

interface.longDescription:
Jetpost is a shared inbox for humans and their AI agents. Turn work from a conversation into a note, send it to someone, and keep working on it together.

Ask ChatGPT to share a plan, get feedback on a draft, or catch you up on what your team has been discussing. People can read, comment, and edit in Jetpost, while their connected agents can pick up the same notes and contribute. Changes made by agents are marked so you can see who wrote what.

Send a note to anyone by email, even if they haven’t used Jetpost before. Keep personal notes private and choose who can read, comment on, or edit what you share.
capabilities: Create notes and share them with teammates
Email a note to anyone, even people not on Jetpost
Search and read notes you wrote or received
Edit or add to a note
Comment on a note or reply in a thread
defaultPrompt: Turn our research into a note I can share with my team

positive.description: Save a decision as a private note
positive.prompt: Make a Jetpost note of what we decided: the spring blend launches on the site March 15. Keep it just for me.
positive.expected_behavior: A new note appears in the account's Jetpost inbox, shared with no one, and the reply links to it.

positive.description: Write a note and share it for comments
positive.prompt: Make a Jetpost note with a short checklist for the café rollout and share it with Kyle Williams so he can comment but not edit.
positive.expected_behavior: The note is created and shared with Kyle Williams with comment access. No email is sent unless the user asks.

positive.prompt: What's new in my Jetpost inbox?
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of recent notes and activity (Pricing, Onboarding, Launch plan), with links.

positive.prompt: Read the comments on the Pricing note and reply to Kyle's question about the Office plan.
positive.expected_behavior: The reply appears under Kyle's message in the Pricing note's chat, marked as written by the agent.

positive.prompt: In the Onboarding note, change "two weeks" to "ten days" and add a line on who owns each step.
positive.expected_behavior: "two weeks" becomes "ten days" in the Onboarding note and the new line is added; the change is marked as the agent's.

positive.description: Email a plan to someone not on Jetpost
positive.prompt: Make a Jetpost note of this launch plan and send it to sam@acme.com.
positive.expected_behavior: The note is created and emailed to sam@acme.com, who gets an account waiting for them; the reply links to the note.

negative.description: General question unrelated to notes. Jetpost should not be called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto today?

negative.description: Coding request unrelated to notes. Jetpost should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

negative.description: Another service's data. Jetpost has no access to email, so it should not be called; ChatGPT says it can't read Gmail through Jetpost.

review.commerce_description: Jetpost does not sell products or process payments.
